The '''Durgen's Star system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained [[Durgen's Star/Legends|Durgen's Star]].
